why.B1.1: High blood glucose and distinctive rash are consistent with glucagonoma, a rare tumor of the pancreas.

The presence of a painful rash and elevated blood glucose are highly suggestive of glucagonoma, a rare tumor of the pancreas that produces excess glucagon, which is the most likely underlying pathophysiology of this patient’s condition.
High blood glucose and painful rash are characteristic symptoms of glucagonoma, which distinguishes it from other metabolic/endocrine disorders.
